verdict.rationale: Smooth's primary interface is the API (task run, sessions, custom tools, extraction, event sending) with the CLI acting as a thin wrapper on top of it, suggesting the API is close to feature-complete. However, there's no dashboard/UI described beyond a live-view/take-over feature, and no explicit statement confirming that UI-only actions (like manually taking over a live browser session) are also achievable via the API. missing for 10: explicit UI vs API parity statement, evidence of a full dashboard whose features are all API-accessible, confirmation that live-view interactive takeover can be done programmatically.
